description: This file is a command-line interface (CLI) script for the 'universalinit' project, providing functionalities to initialize various project types, parse parameters, generate configuration dictionaries, and handle 'get run command' requests. It leverages classes like ProjectConfig, ProjectType, and ProjectInitializer, and defines multiple functions to support the CLI operations, including argument parsing and output formatting.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object representing project settings, including name, version, description, author, project type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class representing different supported project types, with method 'from_string' to parse type from string input.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains initialization info for templates, including commands for environment setup, build, install dependencies, and other configurations.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating templates, initializing projects, and managing project setup workflow.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parse a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriately typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Constructs a ProjectConfig object from command line arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object for retrieving template information without full project details.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Convert a relative file path to an absolute path based on the given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Convert a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for file-related entries, suitable for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Format and output the result as JSON, indicating success or failure, with optional template config details.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Output the run command for a specific project type as a JSON structure.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handle the logic for retrieving and printing the run command for a given project type, catching exceptions.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI application, parsing arguments, managing control flow for project initialization or fetching run command.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
